bugs.summary: parse_Rd(): return on an unterminated [option] or \Sexpr{} instead of looping forever
bugs.creator: kevinushey

comments.creator: kevinushey
comments.text:
## Summary

With this patch, a missing `]` in an Rd file, as in `\link[stats{lm}`, gives a parse warning instead of hanging `tools::parse_Rd()` and with it `checkRd()`, `R CMD Rdconv` and `R CMD INSTALL`. Fixes a reproducible hang on malformed Rd input, also hit by fuzzing.

## Details

Input ending inside `\Sexpr{}` (with unbounded memory use) or the second argument of `\eqn`, `\deqn` or `\figure` hangs the same way. In `src/library/tools/src/gramRd.y`, `Arg` recovers from end of input after an error via `'{' ArgItems error END_OF_INPUT`; `Option`, `RLikeArg2` and `VerbatimArg2` have no such alternative. Error recovery there discards `END_OF_INPUT` and reads on, and `con_getc()` returns a newline at every other read past the end, so recovery never runs out of input. Tested at r90939; R 4.6.1 behaves the same.

Reproducible example: attached as `rd-sexpr-eof-hang-repro.R`; a six-line Rd file with that typo and five fragments all hang (each killed after 5 s), while a `\code{x` control returns.

Proposed patch: attached as `rd-sexpr-eof-hang.diff`; it adds the `Arg` alternative to the three rules (`gramRd.c` regenerated with bison 3.8.2) and tests to `tests/reg-fuzz.R`. Of 13,412 truncated copies of the base R Rd files, only the 23 that hung parse differently.

The patch is also submitted as https://github.com/r-devel/r-svn/pull/516, where CI results can be seen.

comments.text:
Created attachment 4127
Updated patch: END_OF_INPUT recovery plus the mkText() backslash fix (against r90939)

Fuzzing `parse_Rd()` with this patch turned up a second hang in the same parser: inside an `[option]`, a backslash before anything other than a letter, `{`, `}`, `%` or `\` loops forever, even in well-formed input such as `\link[=foo\_bar]{x}` (R 4.6.1 too). In `mkText()` the `'\\'` case falls through to `case ']'`, which in an option stops the token without consuming the backslash, so the lexer returns empty `TEXT` tokens forever.

The updated patch adds the missing `break;` and a regression test, and replaces attachment 4125. The truncated Rd files still parse exactly as before apart from the former hangs, and `make check` passes.

Patch also at https://github.com/r-devel/r-svn/pull/516
